items.text: 123 of this library's classifier verdicts are for pairs outside the ones we report: 113 were made with a looser matching setting than the library's documented one (similarity below 0.80; iteration 3 ran at 0.72 with up to 4 matches per claim), and 10 no longer rank among each claim's top 2 matches. None of them is a disagreement, and none is counted.
